# Ollama Mode

Force the use of local Ollama models for this request. Bypasses cloud APIs and runs entirely on your local machine.

## Available Models
- qwen2.5:1.5b (fast, ~2s)
- qwen2.5:3b (balanced)
- qwen2.5:7b (quality)
- qwen2.5:14b (best quality)
